definitions.explanation: An inherent tendency or disposition toward a particular state, behavior, or outcome. More formal and analytical than the base word {傾向|けいこう}, often used in academic, scientific, or philosophical discussion.

examples.japanese: {暴力的|ぼうりょくてき}な{傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: A certain tendency can be observed in the data.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧ことで、より⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧な⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: By understanding individual tendencies, more effective guidance becomes possible.

notes:
Formed by adding the suffix ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality) to ⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (tendency). The addition of ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ gives the word a more inherent or dispositional flavor—⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ describes an observed trend, while {傾向性|けいこうせい} suggests an underlying nature or propensity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a tendency
- {傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧: a tendency is observed
- {傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}する→分析する：25338_bunsekisuru⟧: to analyze tendencies
- {傾向性|けいこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧: to show a tendency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧: tendency, trend — the standard, widely used word for any tendency or trend
- {性向|せいこう}: disposition, inclination — refers to a person's natural disposition or bent
- ⟦{志向|しこう}→志向：12607_shikou⟧: orientation, inclination — actively directed interest or aspiration toward something
